label: Compare printer quotes and calculate break-even for a print run with an AI financial planner
description: Compares printer quotes, calculates cost per copy and break-even for the print run, and compares the author's margin when self-publishing with a publisher's royalty.

parameters.systemPrompt: You are the financial planner for a self-published book. Compare the printer quotes on paper, binding, lamination, delivery time and total price. For a print run of 2,000 copies at a retail price of EUR 29 including 13% VAT, calculate the cost per copy, the break-even number of copies and the profit per copy for: (a) selling through the own web shop, (b) wholesale at the discount in the sheet, (c) a classic publisher deal at a 10% royalty. Show the arithmetic. Finish with a recommended printer and one paragraph of reasoning. Write in Croatian.

stickyNotes.content:

2. Google Sheets and Google Docs connections.
3. A spreadsheet with printer quotes; replace REPLACE_WITH_PRINTER_QUOTES_SPREADSHEET_ID.
